glosses: to bring to some place by rolling

examples.text: Wielki kamień przed dworem w Lipowej, który przed ośmiu laty przytoczył tu Mikołaj, pokryty był prawie w całości drobnym mchem.
examples.translation: The large rock in front of the manor in Lipowa, which Mikołaj had rolled there eight years ago, was covered almost entirely in fine moss.
examples.english: The large rock in front of the manor in Lipowa, which Mikołaj had rolled there eight years ago, was covered almost entirely in fine moss.

examples.text: Akurat Paul przytoczył do nas wózki załadowane slajdami, więc skorzystała z okazji i zręcznie zmieniła temat: - To dla ciebie czy dla mnie?
examples.translation: Then Paul happened to roll some carts loaded with slides up to us, so she took advantage of the opportunity and nimbly changed the subject: "Is this for you or for me?"
examples.english: Then Paul happened to roll some carts loaded with slides up to us, so she took advantage of the opportunity and nimbly changed the subject: "Is this for you or for me?"

examples.text: Etan, który przytoczył się do nich na krześle, poparł ją energicznie.
examples.translation: Etan, who had rolled himself up to them on his chair, energetically supported her.
examples.english: Etan, who had rolled himself up to them on his chair, energetically supported her.

glosses: to quote, to cite (to repeat another's words verbatim or nearly so)

examples.text: Sąd uznał jednak, że wyrok I instancji trzeba uchylić w całości, gdyż nie została rozpoznana istota sprawy. Pozew małżonków N. dotknięty był bowiem brakiem formalnym. Chodziło o to, że formułując żądanie pozwu przytoczyli niemal dosłownie treść nakazu zapłaty, który został przeciwko nim wydany w 2012 r.
examples.translation: However, the court decided that it had to fully overrule the verdict of the first trial, in which the main point of the case was not recognized. This was because the N. husbands' suit was affected by a formal flaw. Namely, in formulating their demand in the suit, they quoted, nearly verbatim, the text of the injunction for payment which was issued against them in 2012.
examples.english: However, the court decided that it had to fully overrule the verdict of the first trial, in which the main point of the case was not recognized. This was because the N. husbands' suit was affected by a formal flaw. Namely, in formulating their demand in the suit, they quoted, nearly verbatim, the text of the injunction for payment which was issued against them in 2012.

glosses: to list, to enumerate, usually as evidence for something

examples.text: Samorządowcy przytoczyli dane uzyskane od Wód Polskich, z których wynika, że na 196 projektów zgłoszonych do dofinansowania z tego działania, tylko 20 posiada dokumentację techniczną i jest gotowa do realizacji.
examples.translation: The local officials gave data received from [the administration of] Polish Waters, according to which, of 196 projects proposed for funding from this initiative, only 20 have technical documentation and are ready to be implemented.
examples.english: The local officials gave data received from [the administration of] Polish Waters, according to which, of 196 projects proposed for funding from this initiative, only 20 have technical documentation and are ready to be implemented.
